Bill.BriefDescription: Developing policies, procedures, and mandatory training programs on sexual harassment for all state employees.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to developing policies, procedures, and mandatorytraining programs on sexual harassment for all state employees; addinga new section to chapter 41.06 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 41.06 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The director shall adopt rules, under RCW 41.06.400(2)(b),developing policies, procedures, and mandatory training programs onsexual harassment for all state employees.
